name_note: Most genomes GTDB places in g__Gemmiger carry the NCBI names Gemmiger or Subdoligranulum, so papers on Subdoligranulum variabile describe members of this GTDB genus.

sentences.text: It ferments a variety of sugars, producing formic, butyric and lactic acids.
Subdoligranulum variabile, a close relative, was isolated from human faeces and its nearest named relative is Faecalibacterium prausnitzii.
In metagenomes from overweight and obese adults, Subdoligranulum stood out among species whose abundance tracked that of Akkermansia muciniphila.
A study reported that antibodies from people at risk of rheumatoid arthritis cross-react with gut taxa, and that a Subdoligranulum isolate bound antibodies and activated T cells from patients.
